Description: Susceptible people exposed to contaminated water become infected; force of infection depends on contact rate (β), bacterial concentration (B), and half-saturation constant (κ)
People are born into the susceptible population (birth rate)
Infectious people recover and become immune at recovery rate γ
Infectious people shed V. cholerae into the water reservoir at contamination rate ξ
Death due to cholera infection or other causes
Bacteria decay/removal from the water reservoir at rate δ

Name: β
Description: Rate of contact between susceptible population and contaminated water reservoir

Name: 1/δ
Description: Cholera life span in water reservoir (bacterial decay time)

Name: ξ
Description: Rate of water contamination by humans, i.e. rate of increase in V. cholerae concentration in the water reservoir

Name: κ
Description: Concentration of V. cholerae at which the infection rate is 50% of the maximum infection rate β
